title: unified rollouts: integrate canary/A-B/shadow autorollback workflows with orchestration
author: Priya Shah
description: Motivation: Bring canary, A/B and shadow traffic rollouts under a single orchestrated workflow with automated rollback to reduce toil and improve safety when serving new model variants. This PR integrates the autorollback state machine with the unified rollouts engine, standardizes metric evaluation, and wires observability hooks for faster incident diagnosis. Design summary: 1) Add a rollout orchestration stage that supports canary, weighted A/B, and shadow probing modes and emits unified events for metric evaluation. 2) Introduce a composite metric evaluator that accepts multiple signals (latency p50/p95, error-rate, quality-regression from eval hooks, and quarantine metric quorum) with configurable weights and quorum thresholds. 3) Implement a gated autorollback runner that can trigger immediate rollback, quarantine, or gradual traffic reduction based on evaluator output and safety-guards. 4) Expose rollout controls via Console API and rollout config spec (canary.percent, probe.window, rollback.policy, quarantine.metric). Scope: - Core changes in rollout orchestration and autorollback engine; - Adapter changes to serving runtime for shadow traffic tagging and sampling; - Observability additions: new metrics, tracing spans, and dashboard panels; - E2E tests and new integration test harness that simulates degradations. Checklist: - [x] Unified rollout orchestration stage with canary/weighted/AB/shadow modes - [x] Composite metric evaluator with quorum and weight config - [x] Autorollback runner with safety guards and log hooks - [x] API/Console schema updates and docs stub - [x] Unit tests for evaluator logic - [x] Integration tests for canary->rollback path - [x] Observability dashboards and alert rule updates - [x] Migration path for existing rollout configs. Testing: Local unit tests and CI integration harness simulate noisy latency and quality regressions; ran canary->rollback e2e in staging with synthetic traffic; manual soak test for 6 hours on dedicated cluster. Rollout plan: Feature-flagged rollout behind experiment flag rollouts.v2 enabled=false by default; staged enable across canary-hosted customers, then full rollout after 2 weeks of monitoring. Related: linked Linear items ENG-2104 (autorollback design) and ENG-2189 (metric evaluator). See docs PR in redwood-docs for spec changes. Notes: No breaking API changes; config migration warns on deprecated fields.
